description: Grapheme counting for Lexicon maxGraphemes/minGraphemes (docs/spec/data-model.md sec. 2.2): extended grapheme clusters (UAX #29) as computed by the pinned unicode-segmentation (1.13.3, Unicode 17.0). input: {text} or {gen: {prefix, repeat, times, suffix}} meaning prefix + repeat x times + suffix; expected: graphemes (extended grapheme clusters) and bytes (UTF-8 length). Runners also check the boundary through validity rule G2: a post whose title (s(300g/3000b)) is the text is G2-valid iff graphemes <= 300 and bytes <= 3000. Strings are written with \uXXXX escapes. A new unicode-segmentation version must pass these vectors unchanged.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.note: no clusters

vectors.name: ascii
vectors.note: one cluster per ASCII letter

vectors.name: crlf
vectors.note: GB3: CR LF is one cluster

vectors.name: lf-cr
vectors.note: GB4/GB5: LF then CR are two clusters

vectors.name: tab
vectors.note: GB4/GB5: a control is its own cluster

vectors.name: combining-acute
vectors.note: GB9: e + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT

vectors.name: precomposed
vectors.note: U+00E9 (NFC of the previous vector); no normalisation is applied

vectors.name: stacked-marks
vectors.note: GB9: any number of Extend

vectors.name: zwj-family
vectors.note: GB11: emoji ZWJ sequence (man, woman, girl, boy), 25 bytes

vectors.name: zwj-after-letter
vectors.note: GB9 extends a with ZWJ; GB11 needs Extended_Pictographic on both sides

vectors.name: skin-tone
vectors.note: GB9: emoji modifier (Extend)

vectors.name: modifier-alone
vectors.note: a lone emoji modifier

vectors.name: variation-selector
vectors.note: GB9: VS16 is Extend

vectors.name: keycap
vectors.note: GB9: digit + VS16 + COMBINING ENCLOSING KEYCAP

vectors.name: flags
vectors.note: GB12/GB13: regional indicators pair up (US, GB)

vectors.name: flags-odd
vectors.note: GB12/GB13: a third regional indicator starts a new cluster

vectors.name: hangul-jamo-lvt
vectors.note: GB6/GB7: conjoining jamo L V T

vectors.name: hangul-syllables
vectors.note: two precomposed syllables (LVT, LVT)

vectors.name: hangul-lv-t
vectors.note: GB7: LV syllable + T jamo

vectors.name: devanagari-conjunct
vectors.note: GB9c (Unicode 15.1+): KA + VIRAMA + SSA is one cluster (two under Unicode 15.0)

vectors.name: devanagari-conjunct-zwj
vectors.note: GB9c with ZWJ between the linker and the consonant

vectors.name: devanagari-spacing-mark
vectors.note: GB9a: KA + VOWEL SIGN I (SpacingMark)

vectors.name: thai-sara-am
vectors.note: GB9a: SARA AM is a SpacingMark

vectors.name: prepend
vectors.note: GB9b: ARABIC NUMBER SIGN is Prepend

vectors.name: lone-mark
vectors.note: a combining mark with no base
